title: 4-Day Upper Body and Core Workout Plan for Gym
author: Steven W.
desc: This 4-day gym program is designed for a 70-minute session, focusing on upper body and core strength using free weights and machines, avoiding leg exercises due injury. Each exercise includes 3–4 sets of 10–14 reps with 2-minute rests between sets. Sessions include a 5-minute warm-up and 5-minute cooldown. Consult your doctor before starting.
